awards.activity: The project will deliver a full pitch replacement of the Carter Field at the National Hockey Centre in Lyneham, including a new International Category 1 surface, along with upgrades to the irrigation and fencing.

The project will deliver the construction of footpaths, play equipment, public amenities, sport and recreation infrastructure, gathering spaces, picnic and BBQ area, lighting, signage, landscaping and car parking.
